title: Normalized augmentation of the completed reduction tower
statement: For an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and a scheme T, the quotient scalar adjunctions define a unique natural transformation from the constant strict module tower to the reduction tower whose n-th component sends x to 1 tensor x. Deriving this morphism gives a unique natural transformation from the exact derived constant tower to the specified left-derived reduction tower, normalized on every K-flat representative by its universal reduction counit and the constant-tower localization factors. These constructions are independent of any pullback or completion comparison.

proof.text: Use the tensor-unit normalized scalar adjunction at every quotient. Quotient transitions preserve one, so these units give a strict tower map. Naturality and sectionwise extensionality prove the ordinary uniqueness.

Lift the homotopy-level augmentation through the universal left-derived reduction counit. Its factorization equation gives the cochain formula. On a K-flat representative the counit is invertible, so this formula determines the augmentation. Every derived object has such a representative; naturality gives uniqueness on all objects.
